description: Manually verified acceptance set for official website and public business-contact discovery. Identity = official FNS EGRUL (supplier_radar_p5 pilot rows, P5-001A.1). Expected values were established by hand BEFORE the discovery code was written: candidate sites came from manual web search (directory pages were only leads), then the company's own pages were fetched raw and inspected for the INN / OGRN and for the contacts printed on them. Nothing here was produced by the enrichment pipeline.
inspected_by: Claude (manual inspection, stdlib fetch of the raw pages; search summaries from directories were never used as truth)

rules.official_website: Registrable domain. 'expected_official_domains' empty = no official website could be verified manually (none found, unreachable, or identity not published).
rules.phones: Normalized 7XXXXXXXXXX. 'acceptable' = public business numbers printed on the official site (or the EGRUL record). 'forbidden' = numbers that must never be returned (fax, person-associated, wrong company).
rules.emails: Lower-case. 'acceptable' = business mailboxes printed on the official site or registered in EGRUL. 'forbidden' = personal / wrong-company mailboxes.
rules.forbidden_domains: Sites that must never be returned as this supplier's official website (directories, portals, other companies, similar names).
rules.same_company_domains: Domains of the same company / group whose pages do not prove this INN: returning one is not a wrong-company match, but not a correct verified website either.
rules.adversarial_checks: Forced candidates fed directly to the website verifier; each must NOT end VERIFIED_* (REJECTED or UNKNOWN when unreachable).
